members.description:
𝐅𝐎𝐔𝐍𝐃𝐄𝐑 𝐎𝐅 𝐊𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐒𝐄 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐌𝐔𝐍𝐈𝐓𝐘 (𝐗𝐈𝐕)

Revo is the founder of Katorse Community (XIV) and the person behind its creation. What started as an idea from his passion for Call of Duty: Mobile eventually grew into a community built on competition, teamwork, and growth.

During XIV's early days, Revo became known in the CODM community for his aggressive gameplay and trash talk. His actions caught the attention of many players, resulting in reports and public posts about him. Despite the negative attention, this also helped bring recognition to XIV.

As the community continued to grow, XIV went through different chapters, including challenges, setbacks, and rebuilding. Through these changes, Revo remained an important part of its history as the person who started it all.

𝐅𝐎𝐑𝐌𝐄𝐑 𝐇𝐄𝐀𝐃 𝐀𝐃𝐌𝐈𝐍𝐈𝐒𝐓𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑 𝐎𝐅 𝐊𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐒𝐄 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐌𝐔𝐍𝐈𝐓𝐘 (𝐗𝐈𝐕)

Yara's journey with Katorse Community (XIV) is defined by resilience, dedication, and an unwavering sense of responsibility. Although she was not part of the community when it first began, she already had a vision for what XIV could become.

When the co-founder stepped away, Yara witnessed the community gradually losing its momentum. Members began leaving, group chats became silent, and the community's downfall became a subject of discussion among others. Despite having a personal relationship with the founder, she never used that connection to secure a position within the community. Instead, she chose to observe, understand its situation, and consider whether she was ready to carry the responsibility of managing it.

Her opportunity came near the end of a CODM season, when many leaderboard players were waiting for their seasonal banners. Seeing the need for someone to step up, Yara took on administrative responsibilities and began helping XIV regain its activity.

Little by little, she contributed to its growth. From recruitment and member management to resolving internal issues, creating banners, developing new masterlists, upgrading logos, and improving the community's social media presence, she worked behind the scenes to give XIV a stronger identity and direction. Every improvement became another step toward rebuilding the community.

𝗛𝗼𝘄𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗿, 𝗴𝗿𝗼𝘄𝘁𝗵 𝗱𝗶𝗱 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝗺𝗲𝗮𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗮𝗯𝘀𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗯𝗹𝗲𝗺𝘀.

Internal conflicts, betrayals, and members who shared information outside the community created serious cracks within XIV. These problems eventually became significant factors in the disbandment of X1V. After everything that happened, Yara accepted that Katorse might no longer have a future.

𝗕𝘂𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘄𝗮𝘀 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝗻𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝗶𝘁𝘀 𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆.

Weeks after the disbandment, former members began reaching out to her, asking if XIV could return. Even the founder encouraged her to bring the community back. She considered the decision repeatedly, knowing that rebuilding a community with a reputation as the most hated would mean accepting another heavy responsibility.

Initially, she was reluctant. She understood the challenges waiting ahead. But when the head administrator also reached out to her, alongside the continued support of former members, she finally made her decision.

𝗫𝗜𝗩 𝘄𝗮𝘀 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗯𝗮𝗰𝗸.

The return made a significant impact on TikTok, where news of XIV's comeback quickly spread. Former members returned, new members joined, and a new chapter began.

𝗬𝗲𝘁, 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗰𝗵𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗲𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗼𝘄𝗲𝗱.

As the community grew, so did the attention and criticism surrounding it. Public rants, accusations, and conflicts began involving XIV and its members. Some chose to leave to protect themselves, including people Yara considered important to the community and even some of her own friends. She also witnessed members of the management stepping away.

Despite everything, she remained firm in her decision not to let the community fall apart again.

𝗢𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗹𝗲𝘀 𝙔𝙖𝙧𝙖 𝘀𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗲𝗱 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗵𝗲𝗿 𝗮𝗱𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀 𝘄𝗮𝘀:

"𝘐𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘶'𝘳𝘦 𝘪𝘯 𝘢 𝘸𝘢𝘳 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘭𝘦𝘧𝘵 𝘢𝘳𝘮 𝘨𝘦𝘵𝘴 𝘤𝘶𝘵 𝘰𝘧𝘧, 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘬𝘦𝘦𝘱 𝘭𝘰𝘰𝘬𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘢𝘵 𝘪𝘵 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘳𝘺𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘢𝘣𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘸𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘺𝘰𝘶'𝘷𝘦 𝘭𝘰𝘴𝘵? 𝘕𝘰. 𝘠𝘰𝘶 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘵𝘦𝘤𝘵 𝘸𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘳𝘦𝘮𝘢𝘪𝘯𝘴 𝘰𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘶."

That mindset became part of how she handled XIV's struggles. She learned to focus on the members who stayed rather than allowing every departure, accusation, or public argument to dictate the community's future.

Throughout her time in management, she experienced almost every kind of challenge: inactive group chats, a community losing its momentum, public controversies, broken trust, internal betrayals, and the departure of people she once worked alongside. There were moments when everything seemed to be falling apart, but she continued choosing to rebuild rather than disband.

As conflicts escalated, the situation eventually reached a point where public disputes extended to exposing internal records and masterlists. Yara decided that XIV could no longer remain silent and began confronting the accusations publicly. Eventually, the founder and his associates moved forward, and those involved in the conflicts chose to make peace.

For Yara, however, the greatest achievement was never about winning arguments or proving others wrong. It was about keeping XIV alive long enough to see what it could become.

𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗙𝗜𝗥𝗦𝗧 𝗔𝗡𝗡𝗜𝗩𝗘𝗥𝗦𝗔𝗥𝗬

November 15, 2026, marked a particularly meaningful milestone for Yara.

The celebration of XIV's first anniversary, highlighted by the XIV 1st Anniversary Showdown, was more than just an event. It represented something she had worked hard to bring back and maintain despite countless setbacks.

Seeing the community celebrate its first anniversary became a personal victory for her. It was a moment when all the effort, sacrifices, difficult decisions, and struggles finally felt worth it.

For someone who had witnessed XIV become inactive, disband, return, and grow again, reaching its first anniversary carried a meaning that went beyond a simple celebration.

𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗖𝗟𝗢𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗣𝗧𝗘𝗥

Now, after everything she has experienced, Yara has decided to step away from management and allow Katorse Community (XIV) to rest while giving herself time to focus on her own well-being.

Her departure marks the closing of an important chapter, but it does not erase the work she has contributed or the memories she has built along the way.

She experienced XIV at its lowest and witnessed it reach milestones that once seemed impossible. She saw members come and go, friendships change, conflicts arise, and new beginnings take shape.

And through it all, Katorse remained one of the most meaningful parts of her Call of Duty: Mobile journey.

Some people build a community from an idea. Others carry it through the moments when it is almost lost. Yara became part of the story that kept Katorse alive.

"𝘐 𝘤𝘢𝘮𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘟𝘐𝘝 𝘸𝘪𝘵𝘩 𝘢 𝘷𝘪𝘴𝘪𝘰𝘯, 𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘺𝘦𝘥 𝘵𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩 𝘪𝘵𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘰𝘴, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘭𝘦𝘧𝘵 𝘬𝘯𝘰𝘸𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘐 𝘨𝘢𝘷𝘦 𝘪𝘵 𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳𝘺𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘐 𝘤𝘰𝘶𝘭𝘥." - 𝙔𝙖𝙧𝙖

𝐌𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐋𝐈𝐒𝐓 𝐌𝐀𝐍𝐀𝐆𝐄𝐑 𝐎𝐅 𝐊𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐒𝐄 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐌𝐔𝐍𝐈𝐓𝐘 (𝐗𝐈𝐕)

Krey is one of the oldest members of XIV, having witnessed almost every change and transition the community has gone through. Known as one of its most active members, he showed consistent dedication and interest in XIV, which eventually caught the attention of the Head Admin.

Despite his young age, he was guided and taught the responsibilities of community management. However, his journey was not without mistakes. One major mistake of his became a turning point that brought XIV into chaos and created difficulties within the administration.

Despite everything that happened, Krey chose to stay and work toward earning back the trust of the management team and its members. Through time, he proved his willingness to take responsibility and continued to grow within the community.

Today, Krey holds an important role in XIV as its Masterlist Manager, carrying significant responsibilities and earning the trust of the members he once grew alongside.

𝐌𝐎𝐃𝐄𝐑𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑 𝐎𝐅 𝐊𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐒𝐄 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐌𝐔𝐍𝐈𝐓𝐘 (𝐗𝐈𝐕)

CYYY is one of the oldest members of XIV and a close friend of its founder. He was once recognized as a top leaderboard player, gaining attention from many players through his achievements. He also held multiple Weapon Leaderboard rankings, contributing to XIV's reputation as a leaderboard-focused community.

During one CODM season, his achievements helped bring recognition to XIV and encouraged more members to pursue their own leaderboard rankings. A leaderboard banner featuring CYYY as its main highlight was posted on XIV's TikTok and reached over 40,000 views, bringing further attention to the community and its leaderboard achievements.

Today, CYYY serves as a Community Moderator, continuing his involvement in XIV and helping maintain the community he has been part of since its early days.

𝐑𝐄𝐂𝐑𝐔𝐈𝐓𝐄𝐑 𝐎𝐅 𝐊𝐀𝐓𝐎𝐑𝐒𝐄 𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐌𝐔𝐍𝐈𝐓𝐘 (𝐗𝐈𝐕)

Duke is one of the oldest members of XIV and has been part of the community's growth since its early days. Known for calling himself the "GOD OF XIV," he is also recognized for his leaderboard achievements and significant contributions to recruitment.

He has played an important role in expanding XIV's membership, putting in extra effort by recruiting players through his TikTok livestreams. Even during a difficult period filled with internal issues, conflicts, and challenges, Duke continued his recruitment efforts and helped the community grow.

He dedicated several weeks to recruitment before becoming occupied with personal commitments. Despite this, he remains part of XIV's recruitment team and continues to hold the position of Recruiter, contributing to the community's growth.
